correctness.rationale: For each module, independent socle images lift to an embedded free submodule because every nonzero submodule of \(R^r\) intersects its essential socle. Saturation forces freeness. Every saturated representation is conjugate to the regular action with stabilizer \(\operatorname{GL}_r(R)\). A rank-\(r\) square-zero target has centralizer block shape \(\begin{psmallmatrix}A&B&D\\0&H&K\\0&0&A\end{psmallmatrix}\), giving the exact target orbit size and fiber \(q^{(s-2)r^2}|\operatorname{GL}_{(s-2)r}(\mathbb F_q)|\). This uses only the explicitly stated hypotheses; the finite verifier checks selected instances but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-target cardinality is a natural representation-variety invariant at maximal socle rank, and the theorem shows previously non-obvious uniformity across all commutative local Gorenstein algebra multiplication types and every finite field and module rank. It explicitly relates intrinsic module freeness to a sharp matrix rank and supplies exact arithmetic fibers, with applications to many distinct truncated polynomial and complete-intersection examples. Special known two-generator cases are treated as illustrations, not independent novelty.
